description:
Weekly review partner that compounds productivity gains over time. Use when:
(1) "weekly review", "what did I accomplish this week?", "compound my gains",
(2) End of work week to review progress, (3) "what patterns are emerging?",
(4) "update the system map", (5) Feeling stuck and need to identify friction.
Reads all system/ files to synthesize progress. Outputs to
system/compounder/week-{date}.md. Feeds insights back to /audit.
